name: pdb-skill
description: Builds replicas of the 1975-76 declassified President's Daily Brief from today's news: multi-source, bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese) briefs typeset as a typewritten booklet PDF plus a Markdown twin, with grayscale CIA-style map plates.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where briefs are written (PDB_<date>.pdf, PDB_<date>.md, PDB_<date>.json and a maps/ folder). An Obsidian vault folder works well when Markdown is the primary format.

primary_format.title: Primary format
primary_format.description: pdf: the print-faithful 1975-76 replica. markdown: Obsidian-flavored Markdown (frontmatter, wikilinks, callouts, image embeds). Both files are written either way; this sets which is reported first and the Markdown flavor.
